# Ozzy's Equipment Hire

> Melbourne-based hire company: VMS message-sign boards, full-colour LED trailer signs and mobile LED screen trailers, delivered, placed and programmed across Greater Melbourne and regional Victoria. Day rates from $45 per day ex GST; short hires of one to six days are a flat $500 plus 8% insurance.

Enquiries go through the quote form, phone (0469 316 068) or email. There is no online checkout and no account system. Each service below has its own page.

## Services

- [VMS sign hire in Melbourne](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/vms-sign-hire/): VMS sign hire in Melbourne from $45/day ex GST. Trailer-mounted variable message signs for roadworks, traffic management and events — delivered, placed and programmed across Victoria.
- [LED trailer sign hire Melbourne](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/led-trailer-sign-hire-melbourne/): LED trailer sign hire Melbourne from $45/day ex GST. Full-colour trailer LED signs for festivals, sport, retail and campaigns — towed in, positioned and collected across Victoria.
- [LED screen trailer hire](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/led-screen-trailer-hire/): LED screen trailer hire in Melbourne for festivals, sport and outdoor events. Mobile LED screen trailer hire with onboard sound and power — delivered, set up and operated across Victoria.

## Pricing

- [VMS and LED trailer hire prices](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/pricing/): VMS sign hire and LED trailer sign hire prices in Melbourne: from $45/day ex GST on a 12-month contract, or a flat $500 plus 8% insurance for one to six days. Live pricing calculator.

- [VMS board vs LED trailer sign vs LED screen trailer](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/guides/vms-vs-led-trailer-sign/): Three trailer-mounted displays, three jobs: amber VMS boards for traffic messaging, full-colour LED trailer signs for advertising, LED screen trailers for event video. How to choose.
